product.description: Tommy și Tuppence Beresford își cumpără o casă nouă, unde speră să își petreacă liniștiți bătrânețea. În timp ce aranjează în mansardă cărțile lăsate de mai multe generații de proprietari, Tuppence descoperă o ediție care o intrigă a Săgeții negre de Robert Louis Stevenson. Mai multe litere din carte au fost subliniate, alcătuind o frază enigmatică: “Mary Jordan nu a murit de moarte bună. Unul dintre noi a ucis-o.” Cartea i-a aparținut unui băiat care a murit la doar paisprezece ani... Cei doi Beresford nu au nevoie de mai mult ca să înceapă o anchetă ce se va dovedi periculoasă. Ultimul roman pe care l-a scris Agatha Christie.

# The Gate of Destiny: A Classic Mystery Novel by Litera

Step into a world of secrets and suspense with *The Gate of Destiny*. This compelling fiction title plunges readers into the cozy, yet dangerous, depths of an old English mystery. Ideal for fans of classic detective stories, this novel promises an unforgettable journey filled with intrigue and unexpected revelations.

## Discovering the Mystery

Tommy and Tuppence Beresford finally settle into their new house, hoping to spend a peaceful retirement together. Amidst the process of organizing the dusty literary treasures left behind by previous owners, they stumble upon an intriguing discovery in the mansard: a copy of Robert Louis Stevensonâs *The Black Arrow*.

What seems like a simple find quickly escalates into a perilous investigation. The book is marked with multiple underlines, forming a cryptic phrase that immediately draws their attention: **"Mary Jordan did not die a natural death. One of us killed her."**

This annotated copy belonged to a boy who passed away at just fourteen years old. Suddenly, the quiet life the Beresfords planned is shattered by a mystery too compellingâand dangerousâto ignore. They are forced to become amateur sleuths, unraveling decades-old secrets that threaten everything they know. As readers, you will be drawn into solving this thrilling puzzle, framed as one of the final great mysteries in the genre.

## Why You Will Love This Detective Fiction

*The Gate of Destiny* delivers a perfect blend of historical charm and nail-biting suspense. If you enjoy classic literature combined with the intensity of Agatha Christie's finest work, this book is for you. It seamlessly blends elements of domestic life with high-stakes detective work, making every chapter a captivating puzzle.

**Key Highlights:**

*   **Intriguing Premise:** The discovery of an annotated historical artifact sparks the entire adventure.
*   **Engaging Characters:** Follow Tommy and Tuppence Beresford as they confront dangerous truths about their past and their new home.
